atoms.b: This is a diagram of a potato plant. The ((stem)) helps the plant stand tall. White, pink or purple ((flowers)) grow on top of the plant.
The ((berries)) look like small, green tomatoes. But be careful! They are poisonous. The ((leaves)) of the potato plant are poisonous as well.
Underground, the stem meets the ((roots)). The end of the roots grow thicker and ((potatoes)) grow.
